semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: Under the constraints 0 ≤ b ≤ a ≤ n/2 for integers n,a,b, define d=a-b, A=n-a, B=b, and for any t≥0 define [n choose t]_q = ∏_{i=1}^t (1-q^(n-t+i)) / (1-q^i) (with ∏_{i=1}^0 = 1). Then [n choose a]_q / [n choose b]_q = ∏_{i=1}^d (1-q^(A+i)) / (1-q^(B+i)), with ∏_{i=1}^0 = 1 (i.e., the RHS product equals 1 when d=0).

statement_nl: For integers n, a, b with 0 <= b <= a <= n/2, let d := a - b, A := n - a, and B := b. Define [n choose t]_q := prod_{i=1}^t (1 - q^(n-t+i)) / (1 - q^i), with the empty product equal to 1 when t = 0. Then [n choose a]_q / [n choose b]_q = prod_{i=1}^d (1 - q^(A+i)) / (1 - q^(B+i)), where the product is 1 if d = 0.
